description: Fix above/below on default branch - skip self-targeting PR creation, create new branch + PR targeting default branch directly

userStories.title: above on default branch creates PR targeting default branch directly
userStories.description: As a developer on the default branch with no PR, I want ots above to create a new branch and PR targeting the default branch directly, so that I can start a new stack without a nonsensical self-targeting PR.
acceptanceCriteria: When current branch equals repo.get_default_branch() and no open PR exists, above() skips the create_initial path entirely
No --create-pr flag is needed when on the default branch
No initial PR is created for the default branch itself — only one PR is created (new_branch -> default_branch)
A new branch is created from the default branch
A new PR is created from the new branch targeting the default branch
A worktree is set up for the new branch as normal
--create-pr flag is silently accepted (no error) when on the default branch
Existing tests for above with --create-pr on non-default branches still pass
New tests cover: above on default branch with no PR (no --create-pr), above on default branch with --create-pr (same behavior), above on non-default branch with no PR still errors without --create-pr
Typecheck passes

No initial PR is created for the default branch itself — only one PR is created (new_branch -> default_branch)
A new branch is created from the default branch
A new PR is created from the new branch targeting the default branch
No PR retargeting occurs (there is no existing PR to retarget)
A worktree is set up for the new branch as normal
--create-pr flag is silently accepted (no error) when on the default branch
Existing tests for below with --create-pr on non-default branches still pass
New tests cover: below on default branch with no PR (no --create-pr), below on default branch with --create-pr (same behavior), below on non-default branch with no PR still errors without --create-pr

userStories.title: Dry-run output reflects simplified flow on default branch
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the --dry-run output to correctly show the simplified plan when running from the default branch, so I know what will happen.
acceptanceCriteria: ots above --dry-run on the default branch shows: create branch, create worktree, push, create PR targeting default branch
ots below --dry-run on the default branch shows the same simplified flow
No mention of creating an initial PR for the default branch in dry-run output
Current PR shown as (none) in the state section
New tests cover dry-run output for both above and below on the default branch
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Interactive mode works correctly on default branch
userStories.description: As a developer using interactive mode on the default branch, I want the prompts to work correctly without asking about creating an initial PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Interactive mode in main.py on the default branch does NOT prompt about creating a PR for the current branch
Interactive mode still prompts for branch name, title, worktree path as normal
The is_interactive check in main.py accounts for the default branch case (no PR needed, so no prompt)
Typecheck passes
